description: It looks like the Apple Finder with one magic touch, it works on Amiga Disk. Custom images aren't supported yet.
Create a new image using one of the two file systems supported.
Sort like a real Amiga champ.
Delete files and folder by either honoring the original settings or using God powers.
An Hex/Ascii viewer that allows you to export the dump of a file.
A small but effective text editor to make startup sequene tweaks or just write a note.
Inspect the disk blocks like a real Amiga surgeon
Set permissions and attributes on files.
Inspet sectors like an Amiga proctologist. Useful to compare two disks.
Retrieve current permissions in the same fashion you do on Finder and with the same shortcuts!
